newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Government decides to make hired assassinations, kidnapping for extortion and possession of automatic firearms non-bailable offensces, Justice Minister G.L. Peiris says.
Government to publish draft of new constitution, without chapter on devolution, in two weeks, Peiris says.
Journalists to picket to protest against increasing attacks on mass media and to protect media freedom.
Treasury imposes freeze on new recruitments into government service this year.

Indian prime minister H.D. Deve Gowda may face threat from Tamil Tiger rebels, conference of senior police officers in Bangalore is told. Police decide to step up intelligence gathering on rebel activity.
More than 200 Sri Lankan youths who went to Malaysia in search of jobs languish in jail.
